title: Quantization compatibility heatmap by hardware, region, and supplier
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Goal: produce a pragmatic, prioritized compatibility heatmap that shows which popular open and licensed LLM variants (dense/LoRA/quantized) are known to run with acceptable perf and numerical fidelity across major GPU families and cloud regions. This artifact will guide Dedicated capacity procurement, Private deployment compatibility checks, and model onboarding prioritization.

Deliverables:
- A matrix (CSV + interactive tableau/Looker) mapping model families -> quantization profiles (INT8, FP16, 4-bit, QLoRA) -> hardware targets (A100, H100, RTX6000, Graviton-class inferencing) -> regions/provider notes (AWS eu-west, GCP us-central, Azure westeurope) with a pass/fragility score and explanation.
- Executive one-pager with recommended short-list of model+quantization pairings for Q2 procurement and Dedicated capacity reservations.
- A short RFC for runtime fallback rules when a quantized variant is unavailable in a region.

Acceptance criteria:
- Heatmap coverage of >= 20 candidate model variants across 6 hardware targets; documented test methodology and reproducible perf/quality scripts in GitHub.
- Decision log with recommended priority list and a follow-on eng work ticket for runtime routing changes if needed.
- Stakeholder review (Platform ENG, Runtime, Sales AE covering enterprise accounts) approved the prioritization and procurement triggers.
